name: AI/ML API
short: Single-key gateway to 10,000+ models from every major lab, with volume discounts, a free playground tier, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Zero markup on any request.

plans.name: Free playground tier
plans.notes: Registered users can try models in the playground for free before paying. Access to Playground included at no cost.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: One billing key for every provider; zero markup — pay the same price as going direct to the provider. Per-model rates vary; see the pricing page for current per-1M-token input/output prices (e.g. Beam 1.0 501B A23B $0.2645/$1.058, GLM-5.3 $0.075/$1.25 per the live table).
